rv.q: "War of the Worlds" is a caper, not a catastrophe.
While Lifeline’s version has its entertaining moments, the comedic approach comes at the expense of the story’s human drama.
Providing a fine finale to their 42nd season, Lifeline Theatre shows why they’re considered one of Chicago’s best.
Lifeline's War of the Worlds is stylish fun, and an assured take on an infamous classic.

cn.t: Critics praise Lifeline Theatre's inventive adaptation of "War of the Worlds," which relocates the classic sci-fi tale to present-day Chicago with an irreverent, community-focused approach that balances comedy with the alien invasion narrative.
